item.title: Ex-OPEC president denies bribe-taking at London corruption trial
item.description: Ex-OPEC president denies bribe-taking at London corruption trial Estelle.Bronkhorst Fri, 01/30/2026 - 09:00 LONDON - Lawyers for Diezani Alison-Madueke, the first woman president of OPEC, denied in a London court that the former Nigerian minister took bribes in their first formal response at her corruption trial. The 65-year-old, who sat in the dock at Southwark Crown Court taking notes on the third day of the trial, is accused of multiple bribery counts stemming from a years-long investigation.
